description: Load on-disk instruction files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / AGENT.md) from the active workspace into the agent's system prompt, with nested directory discovery and @import expansion.
enabledHint: When on, the agent reads project instruction files on every turn (skipped in bare mode).
extraPathsHint: One path or glob per line, relative to the workspace root (e.g. CONTRIBUTING.md or .cursor/rules/*.md).
includeGlobalHint: Also load a user-level instruction file that applies to every workspace.
loadProjectAgentsHint: Discover .cognia/agents/*.md markdown subagents and expose them to the agent.

mode.hint: Layered collects every instruction file from the workspace root down to the working directory; nearest stops at the closest one.
mode.label: Nesting mode

title: Project instructions
